feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 November 2026 9:30pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 20 November 2026 at 9:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure east of Greenland, extending a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, settling east or southeast 3 or 4 overnight, increasing 4 or 5 tomorrow morning, then 5 or 6 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight or moderate tomorrow evening.


##Weather##

Risk of mist in the southeast of the area overnight and at first tomorrow. Isolated showers in the west tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally poor in mist.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 5 or 6, increasing east 6 or 7 overnight, then decreasing 5 or 6 again later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough overnight, then falling slight or moderate on Sunday evening.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with a risk of mist in the southeast of the area at first.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally poor in mist.
